update.title: ODialer 5.0.8 — The Experience Evolves
update.description:
✨ A NEW IDENTITY

Meet the refreshed ODialer experience! The application now features a redesigned ODialer logo sourced from ColorOS 17, bringing its distinctive visual identity to the app.

🎨 COLOROS 17 ICONS

Experience the visual language of ColorOS 17 with icons sourced from its interface, creating a more consistent and familiar design throughout the dialer.

🎬 NEW STARTUP ANIMATION

A new update animation welcomes you when the application starts, adding a more dynamic and polished opening experience.

⚡ MORE REFINED EXPERIENCE

Version 5.0.8 brings together the new branding, visual details, and global animations to make ODialer feel more cohesive and enjoyable to use.
